acceptance_criteria.text: Canonical QQ AI Workflow v9 artifacts are present and manual routing is explicit
Project profile and risk rules cover this FastAPI/Python/Playwright/Gemini/SQLite project without lowering risk
Deterministic workflow tests and GREEN/YELLOW/RED hermetic pilots pass
The migration preserves product progress and does not perform database, browser, live, deployment, or destructive actions

argv: import fs from 'node:fs'; const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.ai-workflow/PROJECT_PROFILE.json','utf8')); const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.ai-workflow/RISK_RULES.json','utf8')); if(p.canonical_version!=='9.0.0'||p.routing_mode!=='MANUAL'||p.project_context.framework!=='FastAPI'||p.project_context.database!=='SQLite'||!Array.isArray(r.rules)||r.rules.length<8||!r.rules.some(x=>x.id==='authentication-or-permission'&&x.risk==='RED')||!r.rules.some(x=>x.id==='database-or-migration'&&x.risk==='RED')||!r.rules.some(x=>x.id==='deployment-control'&&x.risk==='RED')||!r.rules.some(x=>x.id==='external-service-boundary'&&x.risk==='RED')||!r.rules.some(x=>x.id==='user-data-and-privacy'&&x.risk==='RED')) process.exit(1); console.log('PROFILE_RISK_VALID')
